title: Patch: one top-bar layout, so Back is always top left and the gear always top right
thread:
**Issue #3218 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3218: Patch: one top-bar layout, so Back is always top left and the gear always top right
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What it does

The settings gear moves from the right side of the top bar to the left between menus. Measured at 1280x720 on a dev build: the gear is at x=1156 on `/practice`, `/patch-notes`, `/login` and `/`, but at x=112 on `/almanac` (packed right beside Back) and at x=178 on `/stats`. From the code, the deck workshop (`DeckWorkshop.tsx:758`) does the same. Back starts 14 px from the edge on the Almanac and 80 px elsewhere, and on those three screens the page title comes after the gear.

The cause: #3189 gave the bar one *skin* (`routes/top-bar.css`) but no single *layout*. The push of the right-hand group (Jlore pill, Friends, language, gear) to the right edge is a chain of `margin-left: auto` / `margin-left: 0` sibling rules spread over four sheets: `settings/settings.css:50-62`, `i18n/language.css:31-38`, `economy/jlore-pill.css:47-55` and `together/together.css:340-348`. It only works when `.screen-nav` is full width. `.board-rail .screen-nav` (`game/board.css:2032`) and `.invite-screen__top > .screen-nav` (`auth/code-field.css:242`) patch around it. `.db-header` (`deckbuilder.css:53,72`), the almanac header and `.stats-header` (`stats.css:13`) do not.

Other drift in the same bar:
- The replay player's Back (`ReplayPlayer.tsx:230`, `OpenedReplay.tsx:43`, `DuosReplay.tsx:189`) is a bare `.link-button` "← Back" (underlined blue, `index.css:409`), not the `top-bar-button` pill.
- The bar's phone breakpoint is 560 px (`settings.css:66`, `language.css:42`, `together.css:361`), while its touch rule is 600 px (`index.css:428`).
- `top-bar.css` restates raw values where tokens exist: `999px` vs `--radius-pill`, `50%` vs `--radius-round`, `140ms` with no curve vs `--motion-fast` + `--ease-standard`, `44px` vs `--hit-min`, and five raw `rgba()`.

Change: give the bar one layout, owned by `routes/top-bar.css` and `BackLink` (`routes/nav.tsx`), with fixed slots in this order:
1. start: Back (or the landing's nothing)
2. title: the screen's title, if the screen puts one in the bar
3. a flexible spacer
4. end group, in a fixed order: the screen's own extras (the workshop's save status, the invite screen's Sign out), the Jlore pill, Friends, language, the gear

The gear is always the last item at the right edge. Delete the per-sheet `margin-left` chain and the per-screen patches. Route the replay Backs through `BackLink`. In-match placement (the gear in the board's control bar, `placement="game"`) is out of scope.

Also move `top-bar.css` onto the surfaces, motion and palette tokens listed above, and make the bar's phone breakpoint and touch breakpoint the same value.

If this sets a convention the client must keep, record it as a ruling note (CLAUDE.md rule 3), as R1581000 and R2122000 did.

### Acceptance

- A test (unit or e2e; spec `46` already visits every menu at 1280x720 and 390x844) asserts, on every menu screen that shows them, that the gear's right edge is the rightmost of the bar's controls and that Back is the leftmost, at both sizes. This covers at least the landing, Almanac, Statistics, the deck workshop, Patch notes, Practice, Sign in, Shop, Account and the replay player.
- No stylesheet other than `top-bar.css` sets `margin-left`/`margin-right`/`order` on `.settings-button`, the language button, the Jlore pill or the Friends button inside `.screen-nav`.
- The replay player's Back is a `BackLink` (`top-bar-button--text`).
- `top-bar.css` has no raw radius, duration, hit size or color where a token exists (it leaves `UNMIGRATED` in `palette.test.ts`).
- Existing top-bar tests (`routes/top-bar.test.ts`) and e2e specs `46` and `47` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
